title: Janla Diye Bou Palalo
desc: Defying parental expectations, a medical student dreams of rock stardom while a young woman resists an arranged marriage. Their individual escapes spark a chaotic, comical pursuit.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Swapno
desc: A woman leaves a kind-hearted man owing to a misunderstanding and marries his younger brother. However, it turns out that he is the complete opposite of his elder brother.

title: Annaye Atyachar
desc: An inebriated Udayan spends a night with his friend's daughter, Kunti, mistaking her to be his wife. He leaves unaware the next morning, setting off a chain of chaotic events.

title: Sangharsha
desc: In a village divided by corruption and power struggles between a politician and a doctor, honest newcomer Shubhankar challenges the status quo.

title: Baba Taraknath
desc: Amar, an explorer conducting research on snake venom, loves Sudha and the two get married. However, their marital bliss is dampened when an astrologer predicts Amar's death.
